title: ¿Por qué integrarse?
goal: Read how Bolívar's dream of unity, the ALALC (LAFTA), and the 1990s push for new-generation trade treaties after the debt crisis built the case for Latin American regional integration.

items: Explain what Bolívar dreamed of in the nineteenth century.
State what the ALALC was created for.
Explain what limited this first integration attempt.
Explain when the decisive push toward deeper integration came.
Use a fin de que + subjunctive for a shared purpose.
